rules.instruction: All file/media I/O must be capability-based (content URI -> FD). All model loads must use app-private absolute paths from DLStorage.resolveModelPath().

forbid.message: No raw external storage paths; use DLStorage + FileProvider.
Use setDataSource(FileDescriptor, ...) with FD from DLStorage.openReadFd().
Open media via contentResolver + detachFd, not path.

require.message: Model path must come from DLStorage.resolveModelPath().
Media must be opened via capability FD.

forbid.message: Do not open media by path; accept int fd from Java and use fdopen/read.
